title: GET /api/agent/events query (the hello)
description: Opens the long-lived Server-Sent Events stream (Authorization: Bearer <device token>, Accept: text/event-stream). The hello is carried in the query string because a GET has no body: agent_version names the running agent. The network snapshot is not part of the hello; the agent sends it with POST /api/agent/network right after the stream opens. While the stream is open the device is Online; closing it marks the device Offline.
